subject.title: Actualizar layout de pagina de producto

question: Should this PDP layout update land as one coordinated feature PR, or should maintainers split the author, recommendation, breadcrumb, copy, and dimensions work first?
rationale: The requested UI is clear, but the work crosses layout, copy by product type, author enrichment, recommendation ranking, and cache policy, so the delivery boundary needs maintainer intent before repair automation.

options.title: Split into scoped PDP tasks
options.body: Track breadcrumb/details/copy separately from author enrichment and best-seller caching to reduce review and release risk.

options.title: Implement as one feature PR
options.body: Build the full requested PDP layout in one branch if ecommerce maintainers can provide design and data acceptance criteria up front.

options.title: Pause for data/design acceptance
options.body: Keep the issue open but wait for explicit cache, ranking, and visual acceptance criteria before implementation.

recommendation.title: Split into scoped PDP tasks
recommendation.body: Track breadcrumb/details/copy separately from author enrichment and best-seller caching to reduce review and release risk.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent PDP feature work makes this the strongest available owner for choosing how the layout/data update should be delivered.
